source: checkTextContrast() from text-contrast.export.js, plus a targeted read of the Invalid form placeholder. Ratios reflect the displayed modes and visible SOLID fills. This is a specimen text check, not a full accessibility audit; mixed text runs, non-SOLID paint, interaction semantics and unshown modes require separate verification. Refreshed after the Picker addition; separate review contrast (including dark cards) is recorded in picker.json. Common-control source families refreshed; labeled review and dark examples checked separately in common-controls.json. Existing deferred DataGrid exceptions remain recorded.
